summary.name: Time to Leave
summary.one_liner: Time to Leave is a desktop work-time tracking app that logs your hours in a time-card style and notifies you when it's time to leave.
use_cases: Logging daily start, lunch and end times
Getting a notification when it is time to leave the office
Tracking vacation, sick leave or other days off
Setting regular working hours and workdays
Importing public holidays for a country, state or city
summary.what_it_does: The app presents a time-card style interface for recording work time. You log the time you started working today, and it computes when you should leave, accounting for breaks such as lunch. You can switch between Day and Month views to record start, lunch and end times. Settings let you define how many hours you usually work per day and which days you work, and you can pull in holidays based on country, state or city. You can add waivers to non-working days with a reason such as vacation, sick leave or other. It ships with Light, Dark and Cadent Star themes.
notable: Notifies you when it's time to leave, computed from start time and break length
Holiday import by country, state and city
Day and Month views with Light, Dark and Cadent Star themes
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Specific desktop operating systems are not named on the page text
Page text is mostly feature description with little technical detail
